source.title: Google's AI answers reducing search traffic by 40%
source.author: slashdev

title.zh: Google AI Overview如何影响网站搜索点击
title.en: Google AI Overviews and the drop in search clicks

excerpt.zh: Google AI Overview在一项美国桌面端随机实验中使外部网站点击减少约40%；但研究尚未经过同行评审，且其他流量变化原因仍未确定。
excerpt.en: Google AI Overviews reduced clicks to outside websites by about 40% in a US desktop experiment. The working paper is not peer reviewed, and broader traffic trends have other possible causes.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Google AI Overview正改变搜索结果带来访问量的方式。一项针对美国桌面端Chrome用户的随机实验发现，在本会出现AI摘要的搜索中，看到摘要的用户点击外部网站的次数比看不到摘要的用户少约40%。
text.en: Google AI Overviews are changing how search results send visits to websites. A randomized experiment with US desktop Chrome users found that, on searches where an Overview would appear, people who saw it clicked outside websites about 40% less often than people who did not.

text.zh: AI摘要出现更普遍，点击影响因搜索而异
text.en: AI Overviews are widespread, but effects vary

text.zh: DataForSEO追踪的美国关键词中，出现AI Overview的比例从2024年9月约6%升至2026年8月约61%。覆盖率在多种搜索意图中都上升；该报告还称，实验中搜索结束时没有外链点击的比例，从54%升至73%。这意味着即使页面仍能获得排名，摘要也可能减少用户继续访问网站的机会。
text.en: In DataForSEO's tracked US keywords, the share showing an AI Overview rose from about 6% in September 2024 to about 61% in August 2026. Coverage increased across several search intents. In the experiment, the share of searches ending without an outbound click rose from 54% to 73%. A page may still rank, then, while the summary reduces the chance that users visit it.

text.zh: 这项实验为摘要造成点击减少提供了较强的因果证据，但它是尚未经过同行评审的工作论文，只研究美国桌面端用户；对导航和交易类搜索，样本不足以得出确定结论。报告汇总的整体自然点击变化也不能简单归因于AI摘要：研究者指出，桌面端首位结果点击率曾大幅下跌，但同期摘要覆盖率几乎持平，其他因素或许也在起作用。
text.en: The experiment offers relatively strong causal evidence that Overviews reduce clicks, but it is a working paper that has not been peer reviewed and covers US desktop users only. Its samples were too small for firm conclusions about navigational and transactional searches. Nor can broader changes in organic clicks be attributed to Overviews alone: the report notes that desktop click-through rates for the top result plunged while Overview coverage was nearly flat, suggesting other factors may also matter.

text.zh: GEO尚无明确捷径，证据仍有限
报告认为，生成式引擎优化（GEO）目前看起来主要仍是SEO：让内容可被搜索引擎收录，并争取在其他网站和AI答案中获得引用。引用与网站外链特征存在相关性，但相关不代表因果，也不能证明某种优化方法能带来引用。不同AI平台引用来源各有差异，因此在一个平台表现好，不保证在另一个平台也有效。
text.en: The report finds that generative engine optimization (GEO) still looks mostly like SEO: make content indexable and seek visibility on other sites and in AI answers. Citations correlate with backlink profiles, but correlation does not establish cause or prove that a particular tactic earns citations. AI platforms also draw on different sources, so visibility on one does not guarantee visibility on another.

text.zh: 实际影响还存在值得留意的分歧：DataForSEO的模型估算AI摘要引用链接能获得较高点击份额，而Pew的真实浏览记录中，用户点击摘要内链接的比例仅为1%。两组数据的时间和测量方法不同，不能直接互相验证。对网站而言，核心问题不仅是能否被引用，也包括摘要是否为网站带来有价值的访问；目前公开证据尚不能给出统一答案。
text.en: There is also a meaningful gap in the evidence: DataForSEO's model estimates a substantial click share for links cited in Overviews, while Pew's observed browsing data found that users clicked a link inside a summary on just 1% of visits. The datasets differ in timing and method, so they cannot directly validate one another. For publishers, the question is not only whether they are cited, but whether summaries send valuable visits. The available evidence does not yet settle that.
